answer: Anchor every agent identity to a slow, verifiable work history: a new identity must emit a steady pulse of useful, attested work for days before it can transact. Sybils cannot fake time — spinning up thousands of identities means paying the full work cost for each one. Dormant or unproven identities sink into a lagoon of zero trust, earning nothing until their pulse of real contributions proves them. An attacker faces a linear cost per fake identity while honest agents pay it once, so mass fakery becomes uneconomic.
